services.desc: We ran out East today and found BLUES ranging from 2 to 8 pounds. We had a slow pick at times on good readings, with some stops being better than others. We had a tough start on the Mahi Trip due to the unexpected high winds in the Canyon Monday morning. But, we put extra time in and finished the day with Mahi Mahi in the boat. Starting September 23, SEA BASS limits will be 10 per person and we have scheduled an EARLY DEPARTURE SEA BASS TRIP on that day! We’ll depart at 6:30 AM so we can get right out to the SEA BASS fishing grounds and will return at 2:00 PM. Be sure to get your reservations in early and join us for this special trip!
